title: [DEMO] Severe storm conditions affecting Bicol travel
summary: Synthetic demonstration alert: severe rain and wind are affecting sample routes in the Bicol Region.
details: This record exists only to demonstrate Saraya's red-severity safety flow. It is not a current PAGASA bulletin and must not be used for real travel decisions.
advice: Delay exposed land and sea travel in the demonstration area.
For real travel, verify current bulletins with PAGASA and local authorities.
alternatives: Remain at established accommodation until verified local guidance permits travel.
affectedAreaDescription: Demonstration area around Albay and nearby Bicol routes

title: [DEMO] Heavy rain may slow Metro Manila travel
summary: Synthetic demonstration alert: persistent rain may cause localized flooding and traffic disruption.
details: This is deterministic demo content, not an official warning. It demonstrates how Saraya presents a yellow weather advisory while retaining manual travel choices.
advice: Avoid visibly flooded roads and follow local traffic instructions.
alternatives: Use established rail routes where operating normally.
affectedAreaDescription: Demonstration area covering central Metro Manila

title: [DEMO] Selected Central Visayas ferry trips cancelled

details: This cancellation is fictional and intended for product demonstration. Confirm actual sailings directly with port authorities and licensed operators.

title: [DEMO] Routine heat-safety guidance for Davao travelers

details: This green demo advisory illustrates preventive traveler guidance and does not represent a current Department of Health notice.
